known.via: English Wikipedia "Côte Chalonnaise" (a wine place on Wikidata)

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A Burgundy subregion south of the Côte d'Or, on rising ground above Chalon-sur-Saône. It has no Grand Cru vineyards. Pinot Noir and Chardonnay dominate, with some Aligoté and Gamay, and it includes Mercurey, Givry, Rully, Montagny and Bouzeron.
